Capture Motif takes everything you have drawn. Capture Area takes only what is inside the box you drag, and leaves the rest of your drawing alone.
Apple Pencil draws. One finger no longer pans while drawing. Use two fingers to pan, pinch and rotate.
🔷 Shapes
Tap a shape, then draw it on the canvas with Apple Pencil — drag to size it, lift to place. Tap the shape button again to cancel.
🔤 Text
Tap “Add text”, then tap the canvas. To change text later, switch to Edit mode and tap it. Put it on a curved path from its panel.

🖌️ Pattern Brush
Turn a vector path into a brush tip. Uses the selected stroke (Edit mode), or every stroke on the active layer if none is selected.

📦 Motif Brush Set
Turn your captured motifs into a Procreate brush set: one stamp brush per motif. Tick the motifs to include and rename them. Uses the size chosen above.

📚 Layers
New strokes go onto the active (highlighted) layer. Tap a row to make it active, tap its name (or ✎ Rename) to rename it. Every layer works the same way: the names are just labels.

🔲 Canvas Tiling
Shrinks the pattern so it repeats 2×2, 3×3, 4×4 or a custom count (2–8) inside the tile frame. Your artwork is not changed; 1×1 puts it back exactly.
Your original stays as it is. To export, use the normal Export menu.

✂️ Shape Tools
Select a closed vector shape first to use as the base.
The result uses the base shape's own colour and brush, stays a real editable vector path (including any hole it creates), and becomes the new selection. Only closed vector outlines work here — open paths, fills, and painted content aren't supported yet.

🧩 Shape builder
Select a closed shape, turn on Pick shapes, then tap the other shapes you want to combine.
Works on closed outline shapes (draw a shape, or close a path in Edit Path). The result is a normal editable vector shape. Subtract: the top shape cuts the ones below it. Divide: every overlap becomes its own piece. Undo brings the originals back.
〰️ Contour & round corners
Select an outline, then just move Gap, Copies or Thickness — the copies appear and follow as you go.

Thickness change per copy: 0 keeps every copy the same size as the original. Use + for thicker outer rings, − for finer inner ones.
Copies stay linked to the original: change the sliders or edit the original and they follow. Works on open paths too (Outside only). Detach to colour or edit a copy on its own.
Round corners
20
Rounds the sharp corners of the selected closed shape. Undo brings them back. Very thin tips smaller than the radius shrink away, so use a smaller radius for those.

🖌️ Create custom brush
Try it out
Taper length is a percentage of the stroke. A tapered monoline is drawn as a solid brush.
An image tip (a PNG with a transparent background works best) is stamped along the path, like your Motif Brushes.
Grain texture
Any picture works — light areas let the colour through, dark areas hold it back. Greyscale textures give the cleanest result.
Blending
The brush blends with whatever is already on the same layer. Colours can look different on a transparent layer.
Colour variation
Each mark along the stroke shifts slightly from your chosen colour. Not available for a uniform monoline; picture tips need “Colour with current colour” switched on.
Dual brush
Only the parts of the stroke that overlap the second tip are kept, which gives speckled, bristly or stippled marks.
